prompts.A:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production mobile game UI sprite atlas, VARIANT A, isolated on a truly transparent alpha background. A polished illustrated old-money navy, ivory and gold ice timer booster. No lettering, no labels, no checkerboard, no scene, no backdrop, no drop shadows outside sprites.

3 at y390: crack overlay stage1 ONLY: one thin white-icy-blue zigzag hairline across a bar-shaped envelope; absolutely no solid bar or capsule behind it.
4 at y540: crack overlay stage2 ONLY: branching white-blue fissures within the same bar-shaped envelope, greater coverage; transparent between lines, absolutely no base bar.
5 at y690: crack overlay stage3 ONLY: wide fully split jagged connected fracture network across same envelope; transparent between white-cyan lines, absolutely no base bar.
BOTTOM HALF: left region x96..774, y840..1422 contains a rectangular FROST FRAME ONLY, ratio339:291, softly rounded corners. Thin crystalline white-cyan hoarfrost edges and tiny delicate icicles with clear vacant center. Do not draw a cream panel; interior fully transparent. No text. Light restrained frosting, fit entirely within rectangle.
Bottom right region: one luminous delicate SIX-ARM ice crystal star centered at (1120,900), around180px diameter, brilliant center, 6 radial arms only.
Below that exactly SIX DIFFERENT small ice shards arranged in a 3 columns x2 rows grid, centers (900,1140),(1120,1140),(1340,1140),(900,1380),(1120,1380),(1340,1380). Each shard around110px, pale blue semi-transparent faceted body, white rim, six distinct cute angular polygon shapes, fully separated by transparent space. Keep shards simple clean silhouettes.
Style: refined hand-painted casual puzzle game premium UI, soft bevels, crisp exportable shapes, saturated materials, front orthographic view, restrained ornament. Every object must stay in its own specified region.
